site.notes: Area was not glaciated during LGM. Lower Red Rock Lake is separated from Upper Red Rock Lake by alluvial fans. Some sections may correlate with nearby lake sediments in outcrop.

chronology.notes: Authors consider WW-6172 to be the oldest reliable date and, thus, conservatively interpret all sediments below 590 cm as >18,500 cal yr BP. Unclear if core top was used to produce age model.

site.sitedescription: Large, shallow lake surrounded by extensive wetlands situated in the Centennial Valley. Surrounding vegetation is grassland and Artemisia steppe with open forests of Pseudotsuga menziesii in surrounding foothills. Pinus contorta, Picea engelmannii, and Pinus albicaulis occur at higher elevations. Wetland vegetation dominated by Carex spp. and Typha latifolia.
